verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents only the payer side of HTTP 402: its wallets let agents pay x402- and MPP-protected endpoints. Nothing in the evidence shows a developer putting their own API behind a 402 paywall or collecting per-call agent payments. Client-side paying capability belongs to a different story and earns no credit for seller-side monetization.

support.subject: As a developer, I can monetize an API or service with HTTP 402 machine payments that agents pay per call without a checkout UI
